h1: Custom Direct to Garment Personal Protection Equipment
metaDescription: Order custom direct to garment personal protection equipment with full-color DTG printing. Soft, breathable, and compliant. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Direct to garment printing allows your custom personal protection equipment to feature full-color designs, logos, and safety messaging directly on the fabric without a heavy hand feel. This method works best on cotton or cotton-blend PPE like safety vests, lab coats, and high-visibility shirts, where you need vibrant branding that won't peel or crack. Safety managers and marketing directors choose DTG for smaller runs of complex artwork on soft, breathable garments that employees actually want to wear.
heroAltText: Custom direct to garment personal protection equipment with full-color logo printed on a high-visibility safety vest
